parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: The API key obtained from the Memset control panel.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The server product name (that is, testyaa1).

examples:
- name: Get details for testyaa1
  community.general.memset_server_info:
    name: testyaa1
    api_key: 5eb86c9896ab03919abcf03857163741
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: memset_api
return_values.description: Info from the Memset API. Returned: always

return_values.name: backups
return_values.description: Whether this server has a backup service. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: control_panel
return_values.description: Whether the server has a control panel (for example cPanel). Returned: always Sample: "cpanel"

return_values.name: data_zone
return_values.description: The data zone the server is in. Returned: always Sample: "Memset Public Cloud"

return_values.name: expiry_date
return_values.description: Current expiry date of the server. Returned: always Sample: "2018-08-10"

return_values.name: firewall_rule_group
return_values.description: Details about the firewall group this server is in. Returned: always Sample: {"default_outbound_policy": "RETURN", "name": "testyaa-fw1", "nickname": "testyaa cPanel rules", "notes": "", "public": false, "rules": {"51d7db54d39c3544ef7c48baa0b9944f": {"action": "ACCEPT", "comment": "", "dest_ip6s": "any", "dest_ips": "any", "dest_ports": "any", "direction": "Inbound", "ip_version": "any", "ordering": 2, "protocols": "icmp", "rule_group_name": "testyaa-fw1", "rule_id": "51d7db54d39c3544ef7c48baa0b9944f", "source_ip6s": "any", "source_ips": "any", "source_ports": "any"}}}

return_values.name: firewall_type
return_values.description: The type of firewall the server has (for example self-managed, managed). Returned: always Sample: "managed"

return_values.name: host_name
return_values.description: The server’s hostname. Returned: always Sample: "testyaa1.miniserver.com"

return_values.name: ignore_monitoring_off
return_values.description: When true, Memset does not remind the customer that monitoring is disabled. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: ips
return_values.description: List of dictionaries of all IP addresses assigned to the server. Returned: always Sample: [{"address": "1.2.3.4", "bytes_in_today": 1000.0, "bytes_in_yesterday": 2000.0, "bytes_out_today": 1000.0, "bytes_out_yesterday": 2000.0}]

return_values.name: monitor
return_values.description: Whether the server has monitoring enabled. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: monitoring_level
return_values.description: The server’s monitoring level (for example basic). Returned: always Sample: "basic"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Server name (same as the service name). Returned: always Sample: "testyaa1"

return_values.name: network_zones
return_values.description: The network zone(s) the server is in. Returned: always Sample: ["reading"]

return_values.name: nickname
return_values.description: Customer-set nickname for the server. Returned: always Sample: "database server"

return_values.name: no_auto_reboot
return_values.description: Whether or not to reboot the server if monitoring detects it down. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: no_nrpe
return_values.description: Whether Memset should use NRPE to monitor this server. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: os
return_values.description: The server’s Operating System. Returned: always Sample: "debian_stretch_64"

return_values.name: penetration_patrol
return_values.description: Intrusion detection support level for this server. Returned: always Sample: "managed"

return_values.name: penetration_patrol_alert_level
return_values.description: The alert level at which notifications are sent. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: primary_ip
return_values.description: Server’s primary IP. Returned: always Sample: "1.2.3.4"

return_values.name: renewal_price_amount
return_values.description: Renewal cost for the server. Returned: always Sample: "30.00"

return_values.name: renewal_price_currency
return_values.description: Currency for renewal payments. Returned: always Sample: "GBP"

return_values.name: renewal_price_vat
return_values.description: VAT rate for renewal payments. Returned: always Sample: "20"

return_values.name: start_date
return_values.description: Server’s start date. Returned: always Sample: "2013-04-10"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Current status of the server (for example live, onhold). Returned: always Sample: "LIVE"

return_values.name: support_level
return_values.description: Support level included with the server. Returned: always Sample: "managed"

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: What this server is (for example dedicated). Returned: always Sample: "miniserver"

return_values.name: vlans
return_values.description: Dictionary of tagged and untagged VLANs this server is in. Returned: always Sample: {"tagged": [], "untagged": ["testyaa-vlan1", "testyaa-vlan2"]}

return_values.name: vulnscan
return_values.description: Vulnerability scanning level. Returned: always Sample: "basic"
